## Overview

This document summarizes the Deportation Data Project (DDP) daily detention population dataset in parquet format. Two versions are documented:

- The archived **20260330 release** (`data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest_20260330.parquet`), DDP's last published version, spanning October 2022 through March 2026. The first and last dates on which any facility recorded nonzero detention are **2022-10-01** and **2026-03-10**. It remains the pipeline's frozen `ddp_new` input and feeds the archived through-March FY26 comparison.
- The current **20260806 version** (`data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest_20260806.parquet`), recreated from the 20260806 detention stints because DDP no longer publishes the file — see [The 20260806 release](#sec-20260806).

Sections below describe the 20260330 release unless noted.

### Dataset Basics

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Format** | Apache Parquet |
| **Date range** | 2022-10-01 – 2026-03-10 |
| **Total observations** | 888,699 facility-day records |
| **Unique facility codes** | 707 |
| **Variables** | 9 |
| **Missing values** | None |

### Variables

| Column | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `detention_facility_code` | character | ICE DETLOC code |
| `date` | date | Observation date |
| `n_detained` | integer | Total detained population |
| `n_detained_at_midnight` | integer | Population at midnight |
| `n_detained_male` | integer | Male detainees |
| `n_detained_female` | integer | Female detainees |
| `n_detained_convicted_criminal` | integer | Detainees with criminal convictions |
| `n_detained_possibly_under_18` | integer | Detainees possibly under 18 |
| `detention_facility` | character | Facility name |

Unlike the earlier feather-format file, the parquet file does not include a `state` column. State is derived downstream via joins with `facility_roster` or `vera_facilities`.

## Population by Fiscal Year

```{r}
#| label: fy-summary
library(dplyr)

ddp_fy_summary <- tibble::tribble(
  ~`Fiscal Year`, ~`Days`,  ~`Mean Daily`, ~`Max Daily`, ~`Total Person-Days`,
  "FY2023",          365L,        41.1,       1776L,         10611760L,
  "FY2024",          366L,        54.6,       2203L,         14141343L,
  "FY2025",          365L,        70.7,       2940L,         18254136L,
  "FY2026 (partial)", 162L,       98.2,       4130L,         11175237L
)

knitr::kable(ddp_fy_summary, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

Mean daily population is the aggregate across all facility codes. The median facility-day observation is zero, reflecting the large number of hold rooms, staging areas, and low-utilization codes in the data. FY2026 covers October 1, 2025 through March 10, 2026 only.

## Facility Code Coverage by Type

Type assignments use the project's unified type lookup: `detloc_lookup_full` joined to `facility_roster` (most authoritative), supplemented by Vera Institute `type_grouped_corrected` and `ddp_facility_canonical` for codes not in the main lookup.

```{r}
#| label: type-table
tibble::tribble(
  ~`Type`,           ~`Feather (853)`, ~`Parquet (707)`, ~`Both (620)`, ~`Feather-only (233)`, ~`Parquet-only (87)`,
  "Non-Dedicated",        209L,              242L,            206L,             3L,                  36L,
  "Hold/Staging",         181L,              187L,            181L,             0L,                   6L,
  "Federal",              171L,              183L,            170L,             1L,                  13L,
  "Dedicated",             51L,               54L,             51L,             0L,                   3L,
  "Family/Youth",           7L,                8L,              7L,             0L,                   1L,
  "Other/Unknown",          5L,                3L,              3L,             2L,                   0L,
  "Medical",              228L,                1L,              1L,           227L,                   0L,
  "Unclassified",           1L,               29L,              1L,             0L,                  28L
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

The feather-only codes are almost entirely medical facilities (227 of 233). The parquet-only codes are predominantly non-dedicated jails (36), federal facilities (13), and hold/staging codes (6); 28 remain unclassified, meaning they have no match in any of the project's type reference files.

## Feather vs. Parquet Comparison

The feather file covers September 1, 2023 – October 15, 2025. The parquet file covers October 1, 2022 – March 10, 2026. Their overlap period is **September 1, 2023 – October 15, 2025** (776 days).

### Aggregate daily population

Over the overlap period, the parquet total is on average **209 detainees per day lower** than the feather total (feather mean: 44,607; parquet mean: 44,398). No two days are exactly equal. The largest single-day absolute difference is 1,773. The difference is consistent with the feather-only codes contributing approximately 60 ADP during this period — almost all from medical facilities. The parquet-only codes contributed approximately 1 ADP in total over the same period.

### Facility-level agreement

For the 620 codes present in both datasets, over the overlap period:

| Agreement band | Facilities |
|----------------|-----------|
| Exactly equal | 410 |
| Within 1% | 562 |
| Within 5% | 601 |
| Discrepant ≥ 5% | 19 |

Mean absolute difference for shared codes: 0.28 ADP.

The 19 discrepant facilities include several with very low ADP (< 2) where small absolute differences produce large percentages, and one substantive case: **Florida Soft-Sided Facility** (FLDSSFS), which shows 106 ADP in the feather vs. 26 ADP in the parquet over the overlap period.

## The 20260806 release {#sec-20260806}

DDP's 20260806 update no longer ships a facilities-daily-population file, and the generating script (`code/facilities-daily-population-latest.R`) was removed from DDP's repository in July 2026 (commit `bfc8b3fa76`). This project recreates the file from the 20260806 detention stints with `build_ddp_daily_population()` in [R/ddp-daily-population.R](R/ddp-daily-population.R), following DDP's published methodology; the last version of DDP's original script is preserved for provenance at [data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest.R](data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest.R).

**Validation:** rebuilding the 20260330 published file from the 20260515 stints reproduced all 888,699 rows, all six count columns, and all facility names exactly — cell for cell. Differences between the versions below therefore reflect DDP's retroactive data revisions, not method differences.

### Dataset basics (20260806)

```{r}
#| label: fdp-20260806-basics
library(arrow)
library(here)
library(dplyr)

fdp_20260330 <- read_parquet(here("data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest_20260330.parquet"))
fdp_20260806 <- read_parquet(here("data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest_20260806.parquet"))

tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("Date range", "Total observations", "Unique facility codes", "Variables"),
  Value = c(
    paste(format(min(fdp_20260806$date)), "-", format(max(fdp_20260806$date))),
    format(nrow(fdp_20260806), big.mark = ","),
    format(dplyr::n_distinct(fdp_20260806$detention_facility_code), big.mark = ","),
    ncol(fdp_20260806)
  )
) |> knitr::kable()
```

### Population by fiscal year (20260806)

```{r}
#| label: fy-summary-20260806
fdp_20260806 |>
  dplyr::mutate(fy = as.integer(format(date, "%Y")) + (as.integer(format(date, "%m")) >= 10)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(fy) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Days = dplyr::n_distinct(date),
    `Mean Daily` = round(mean(n_detained), 1),
    `Max Daily` = max(n_detained),
    `Total Person-Days` = sum(n_detained),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::rename(`Fiscal Year` = fy) |>
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

As before, "Mean Daily" is the mean across facility-days, and the median facility-day is zero.

### Overlap revisions vs the 20260330 release

In the shared window (2022-10-01 – 2026-03-10, 707 shared facility codes), the two versions differ because DDP retroactively revised stints records between releases:

```{r}
#| label: overlap-revisions
metrics <- c("n_detained", "n_detained_at_midnight", "n_detained_male",
             "n_detained_female", "n_detained_convicted_criminal",
             "n_detained_possibly_under_18")

overlap_cmp <- fdp_20260806 |>
  dplyr::filter(date <= max(fdp_20260330$date)) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(fdp_20260330,
                    by = c("detention_facility_code", "date"),
                    suffix = c("_new", "_old"))

purrr::map_dfr(metrics, function(m) {
  d <- overlap_cmp[[paste0(m, "_new")]] - overlap_cmp[[paste0(m, "_old")]]
  tibble::tibble(
    metric = m,
    cells = length(d),
    exact = mean(d == 0),
    mean_abs_diff = mean(abs(d)),
    max_abs_diff = max(abs(d)),
    total_new = sum(overlap_cmp[[paste0(m, "_new")]]),
    total_old = sum(overlap_cmp[[paste0(m, "_old")]])
  )
}) |> knitr::kable(digits = 4, format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

About 90–91% of facility-day cells are exactly equal; 20260806 totals are roughly 0.2% *lower* than the 20260330 totals over the same window, and individual facility-days can differ substantially where records were revised. These are DDP-side revisions — the same recreation method applied to the 20260515 stints reproduces the published 20260330 file exactly.

```{r}
#| label: code-changes
added_codes <- setdiff(unique(fdp_20260806$detention_facility_code),
                       unique(fdp_20260330$detention_facility_code))
dropped_codes <- setdiff(unique(fdp_20260330$detention_facility_code),
                         unique(fdp_20260806$detention_facility_code))
```

`r length(added_codes)` facility codes appear only in the 20260806 version (`r paste(added_codes, collapse = ", ")`), and `r length(dropped_codes)` codes from the 20260330 version are absent (`r paste(dropped_codes, collapse = ", ")`).

## Data Integration Summary

### Pipeline Targets

The feather file remains the source for `ddp_raw` and all existing FY25-era pipeline targets. The 20260330 parquet is loaded as a frozen `ddp_new` target (it feeds `ddp_codes_new`, `ddp_annual_panel` and the expanded map, facility profiles/directory, and the archived through-March FY26 comparison). The current 20260806 version is rebuilt from the stints and feeds the current FY26 comparison chain:

```r
# Frozen 20260330 release (DDP-published, renamed)
tar_target(ddp_parquet_file,
  here::here("data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest_20260330.parquet"),
  format = "file")
tar_target(ddp_new, arrow::read_parquet(ddp_parquet_file))

# Current: recreated from the 20260806 stints (DDP no longer publishes the file)
tar_target(facilities_daily_population_file, {
  fdp <- build_ddp_daily_population(stints_raw, end_date = as.Date("2026-08-05"))
  out <- here::here("data/ddp/facilities-daily-population-latest_20260806.parquet")
  arrow::write_parquet(fdp, out, compression = "zstd")
  out
}, format = "file")
tar_target(facilities_daily_population,
  arrow::read_parquet(facilities_daily_population_file))
```

The `ddp_facility_summary()` function handles both versions; the `state` column it previously required is treated as optional.

### Canonical ID Matching

DDP facility codes are matched to canonical facility IDs via `detloc_lookup_full`. Match coverage for the 620 shared codes is the same as documented for the feather file. The 87 parquet-only codes are covered by the same lookup where they have known DETLOCs; 28 remain unclassified.

### Canonical ID Space

| ID Range | Count | Source |
|----------|-------|--------|
| 1–398 | ~347 | FY19–FY26 annual stats (frozen) |
| 1001–1053 | 53 | DMCP 2015/2017 only |
| 1054–1203 | 150 | DDP non-hold/non-medical |
| 2001–2025 | 25 | ERO field offices |
| 2026–2186 | 161 | Hold facilities |
| 3001–3226 | 226 | Medical facilities |

## FY26 Comparison Export

The `ddp_fy26_comparison_export` target exports 8 pre-computed RDS files to `data/ddp-comparison-export-fy26/` covering **October 1, 2025 – February 5, 2026** (the ICE data cutoff in the Feb 12 release). The export now uses the current 20260806 daily-population data; the table below reflects the archived through-March (20260330) data state. Every exported RDS carries a `provenance` attribute (source file, dates covered, DDP source URLs, computation timestamp), mirrored in a `_provenance.json` companion file in each export directory. The archived through-March analysis is preserved separately as `ddp-comparison-26-20260330.qmd`, whose export target (`ddp_fy26_comparison_export_20260330`) writes to `data/ddp-comparison-export-fy26-20260330/`:

| Object | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `ice_fy26` | ICE FY26b spreadsheet: 220 facilities, total ADP 67,139 |
| `ddp_fy26` | DDP facility summary for the period (562 codes with peak > 0) |
| `ddp_fy26_keyed` | DDP summary with canonical IDs; `in_ice_fy26` flag |
| `daily_totals_fy26` | Aggregate daily population (128 days; peak 76,271 on 2026-01-16) |
| `unmatched_fy26` | 354 DDP-only facilities; 118 with ADP ≥ 2 |
| `daily_unmatched_fy26` | Daily population for unmatched codes |
| `monthly_unmatched_fy26` | Monthly breakdown by type for unmatched codes |
| `peak_fy26` | Peak summary with geocoding for unmatched facilities |
